8401.ReadyDialog: The Monkey King is my name, all of Heaven is my domain.
8401.CheerDialog: Far have I travelled, further must I go.
8401.ultDialog: Many are the lessons I shall teach you!
8401.atk2Dialog: I shall lay low the gates of Heaven itself!
8401.atk3Dialog: The King of Hell fears my wrath, what chance have you against my staff?
8401.atk4Dialog: Neither smoke nor lies can deceive these eyes

12101.ReadyDialog: Worry not, for I shall walk by your side.
12101.WalkDialog: A life lived wanton is a life lived well.
12101.CheerDialog: 'Tis an easy task, slaying such a feeble foe!
12101.ultDialog: If you've any honor, face your judgment honorably!
12101.atk2Dialog: Allow me to show my mettle!
